sourceReviewNotes: All 12 paper pages, 20 scheme pages and 37 generated source figures visually read. Five first-occurrence SymbolMT glyphs checked against the rendered source.
105 separately practicable tasks; 90/90 census leaves covered. Raw ask scan: 108 lines, with two narrative When statements exempted and retained in context.

SEC archive returned HTTP 403 for the marking scheme. The unmodified SEC document was obtained from https://www.thephysicsteacher.ie/Exam%20Material/LC%20Physics/pdf/Ordinary%20Level/Marking%20Schemes/2014.pdf and every page reviewed.
All ten Q5 parts, eight complete Q11 lightning-passage tasks and all four 28-mark Q12 alternatives retained. Internal any-N responses retain every accepted option and the published stepped tariff.

Full equilibrium forces and metre-stick scale, quoted ice experiment report, all six frequency/length pairs, diode circuit and graph, Curiosity rover data, thermometer and metal-conductivity apparatus, refraction geometry, induction apparatus, nuclear station and radiation paths, bus journey, buoyancy diagram, waveform and 6 V circuit retained.

Sonometer apparatus, force definitions, reflection experiment, induction motion and pressure experiment retain complete alternative methods without adding their tariffs. Full Q12(c) polarisation prompt independently checked after a repeated-word selector initially truncated it.

Original source calculation figures preserve fractions, powers and graphs. An opt-in glyph-order fraction reader handles the interleaved symbols in the Mars calculation and historical circuit formula; previous ledgers retain their default path.

Historical source errors remain visible with explicit clarifications: Q12(a) says sound where speed is the scalar; Q12(d) prints 1.2 × 10⁻³ A although 6/500 is 0.012 A, and repeats the wrong exponent in a voltage calculation whose 0.6 V result is correct. Celsius/Fahrenheit conversion and the old proportionality notation are explained on the relevant cards.

All 2903 prior authored records, 1367 prior Ordinary runtime blocks, the complete Higher runtime file, 545 prior figures, 25 audit records and 12 existing 2014 Higher Atlas mappings remain unchanged. All 279 other subject deck/authored files remain byte-identical.

Atlas links retain original reference topics and all ten repaired Q11 omission topics, adding sound energy and the older current/charge heading. The omission regression checks that reviewed mappings retain every repair and match the complete annual map in both languages.
